charter.objective: Assess the completeness of the currently implemented proactive sequence observer against the envisioned closed sequence-learning system, and produce a planner-ready definition of the complete solution's required outcomes.
research_questions: Which model actions and outcomes are durably observable today, and which remain outside the authoritative evidence boundary?
Can the current system recognize and invoke an existing sequence before the model improvises, or does it only evaluate evidence after a governed run closes?
Can a successful unrecorded path become a complete discovery, qualify, promote, and be reused without manual reconstruction?
When the model identifies that one of its own actions caused an issue, is that causal correction joined to the originating sequence and used to prevent the same wrong step next time?
Can an existing registered sequence be corrected, versioned, requalified, and safely replace its defective version?
What exact evidence-based meanings and transitions should silver and gold have, and how will growth, reuse, and recurrence reduction be measured?
What final end-to-end acceptance behavior proves the system learns both success paths and corrections rather than merely cataloging issues?
charter.supplied_input: The complete system observes model behavior, triggers a correct existing sequence when one applies, records and promotes new proven success paths, corrects defective existing sequences when the model identifies a causal mistake, prevents the wrong step from recurring, and increases evidence-backed silver sequence capture and gold sequence reuse over time.
terminal_rules: PASS requires one core researcher, three independent PASS lenses on identical candidate/envelope hashes, a fresh adjudicator with no actionable research finding, grounded READY records for every planner obligation, validated hashes, and zero active agent slots.
GAPS means research-actionable findings remain inside the frozen scope.
BLOCKED means required accessible evidence or a named approval route is unavailable.
CAP_REACHED means a shared budget cap or repeated actionable-fingerprint rule fired.

source.user_intent: The complete system observes model behavior, triggers a correct existing sequence when one applies, records and promotes new proven success paths, corrects defective existing sequences when the model identifies a causal mistake, prevents the wrong step from recurring, and increases evidence-backed silver sequence capture and gold sequence reuse over time.

requirements.text: Do not grant the observer authority to execute effects, approve actions, promote sequences, modify directives, or bypass lifecycle gates.

requirements.acceptance_intent: Promotion, reuse, correction, quarantine, dismissal, supersession, false match, and recurrence join to candidate identity and affect only declared future rule versions.

planner_obligations.description: Plan immutable feedback and versioned consumption without silent self-tuning.

source.user_intent: The complete system observes model behavior, triggers a correct existing sequence when one applies, records and promotes new proven success paths, corrects defective existing sequences when the model identifies a causal mistake, prevents the wrong step from recurring, and increases evidence-backed silver sequence capture and gold sequence reuse over time.

requirements.text: Feed governed outcomes into future recognition and repair decisions through immutable versioned rules.

requirements.acceptance_intent: One scenario proves unrecorded success becomes silver then gold and is invoked next time; another proves a wrong step is diagnosed, corrected, incorporated, and not repeated.

planner_obligations.description: Plan real-boundary matrices and two lifecycle-spanning acceptance proofs.

source.user_intent: The complete system observes model behavior, triggers a correct existing sequence when one applies, records and promotes new proven success paths, corrects defective existing sequences when the model identifies a causal mistake, prevents the wrong step from recurring, and increases evidence-backed silver sequence capture and gold sequence reuse over time.

requirements.text: Prove the complete loop on real boundaries for success learning and correction learning.

evidence: requirements.json FUT-001 requires a named producer, canonical non-secret event, stable identity, outcome link, observer consumer, and visible failure for every action class.

candidate-round-1.json requirement_statuses CUR-007 establishes that only checked shell argv currently has an authoritative action/outcome path; MCP calls, edits, browser actions, subagents, self-reports, and remote model actions are absent or aggregate-only.
candidate evidence EV-WORK-MEMORY, EV-CHECKED-EXEC, EV-EXECUTOR, and EV-CODEX-CLI ground the current boundary; FUT-004 and FUT-011 define the causal-join and safe-evidence obligations.
raw_findings.practical_consequence: Without an authoritative producer and safe event contract for every in-scope action class, most model behavior remains invisible and causal corrections cannot be grounded.

evidence: requirements.json FUT-002 requires exact compatible-sequence identification and governed activation before dispatch, while FUT-014 requires next-run pre-dispatch selection in the success acceptance proof.
candidate-round-1.json requirement_statuses CUR-002 concludes that recognition is advisory, guard enforcement begins only after explicit activation, and exact identity matching is post-close.
candidate evidence EV-RUNNER-SKILL, EV-GUARD, EV-WORK-MEMORY, EV-OBSERVER, and EV-EXECUTOR grounds the missing interception boundary.
raw_findings.practical_consequence: Until applicability matching and governed activation occur before dispatch, the model can improvise even when a correct registered sequence already exists.

evidence: requirements.json FUT-003 requires one complete discovery built only from the proven ordered success path; FUT-009 requires stable identity, deduplication, collision handling, concurrency control, and noise suppression.

candidate-round-1.json requirement_statuses CUR-003 establishes that automatic capture currently applies only to complete checked governed success and that qualification and promotion remain separately invoked.
candidate evidence EV-CANDIDATE-CONTRACT, EV-OBSERVER, EV-BOOTSTRAP, and EV-RECONCILIATION grounds reusable candidate structure and the missing broader producer.
raw_findings.practical_consequence: A successful path that was not already governed cannot become reusable without manual reconstruction unless planning supplies the ordered-evidence capture, completeness, identity, and deduplication mechanism.

evidence: requirements.json FUT-004 treats self-diagnosis as a signal requiring exact action, failure, blocker, replacement, and verification evidence; FUT-005 requires removal of the proven wrong step; FUT-014 requires lifecycle-spanning non-recurrence proof.

candidate-round-1.json requirement_statuses CUR-004 concludes that no durable producer binds self-diagnosis to an action and that reusable content changes only after explicit bundle editing and successor verification.
candidate evidence EV-BLOCKER, EV-WORK-MEMORY, EV-GUARD, EV-LIFECYCLE, and EV-WORK-MEMORY-TESTS grounds existing correction evidence and the absent synthesis/canonicalization boundary.
raw_findings.practical_consequence: A model-reported mistake can remain only a catalog entry unless planning defines the evidence-backed causal join, corrected canonical content, fail-closed hold, and proof that the wrong step is not selected again.

evidence: requirements.json FUT-006 requires replacement identity, provenance, quarantine, requalification, registered verification, atomic cutover, and preservation of the old version as auditable but non-selectable.
candidate-round-1.json requirement_statuses CUR-005 concludes that current repair evolves one bundle lineage rather than producing an auditable replacement version and cutover.
candidate evidence EV-PROMOTION, EV-LIFECYCLE, EV-RECONCILIATION, and EV-WORK-MEMORY grounds current lifecycle authority and the missing registered-version mechanism.
raw_findings.practical_consequence: Without versioned replacement and atomic cutover, defective and corrected registered content cannot be governed as separately auditable selection objects.

evidence: requirements.json FUT-007 defines silver as a complete proven reusable path and gold as a registered path proven by governed reuse, and requires explicit lifecycle transitions.

candidate-round-1.json requirement_statuses CUR-006 establishes that silver and gold do not currently exist as canonical states, while FUT-007 carries the grounded meanings and required transition set.
candidate evidence EV-DISCOVERY, EV-PROMOTION, EV-REGISTRY, and EV-OBSERVER-E2E grounds the existing lifecycle analogues from which the planner must finalize policy.
raw_findings.practical_consequence: Silver capture and gold reuse cannot be reported or governed consistently until planning turns the grounded meanings into exact machine-readable entry, promotion, demotion, supersession, and expiration rules.

evidence: requirements.json FUT-008 requires measurement of eligible observations, matches, silver creation, silver-to-gold transitions, reuse, corrected reuse, duplicates, known-wrong recurrence, false matches, and evidence holds.
candidate-round-1.json requirement_statuses CUR-006 establishes that effectiveness denominators are absent, and FUT-008 carries the complete required metric families.
candidate evidence EV-WORK-MEMORY and EV-OBSERVER grounds current event and observer state but no complete effectiveness contract.
raw_findings.practical_consequence: The system cannot distinguish genuine learning from increased event volume until each effectiveness metric has a durable definition, eligible denominator, provenance, and threshold.

evidence: requirements.json FUT-013 requires promotion, reuse, correction, quarantine, dismissal, supersession, false-match, and recurrence outcomes to join to candidate identity and affect only declared future rule versions.
requirements.json FUT-009 adds identity precedence, collision, concurrency, boundedness, and unchanged-evidence suppression obligations.
candidate evidence EV-RECONCILIATION, EV-OBSERVER, EV-CANDIDATE-CONTRACT, and EV-WORK-MEMORY grounds existing immutable feedback and identifies false-match and consumption limitations.
raw_findings.practical_consequence: Governed outcomes cannot safely improve later matching or repair unless planning defines how they join to stable identity and are consumed by explicit immutable rule versions without duplicate churn or silent self-tuning.

evidence: requirements.json FUT-010 requires observation, candidate, correction, promotion, level, and reuse state to remain durable, resumable, multi-run, and branch-safe.
candidate-round-1.json requirement_statuses FUT-010 identifies the required synchronization and resume contract and its no-loss/no-duplication acceptance outcome.
candidate evidence EV-WORK-MEMORY, EV-BOOTSTRAP, EV-PROMOTION, and EV-WORKFLOW-STATE grounds existing partial persistence boundaries.
raw_findings.practical_consequence: Interruptions or branch divergence can lose corrections, preserve stale selections, or duplicate candidates unless one ownership and synchronization contract spans the entire learning lifecycle.

evidence: requirements.json FUT-014 requires one scenario where unrecorded success becomes silver then gold and is invoked next time, plus one where a wrong step is diagnosed, corrected, incorporated, and not repeated.
candidate-round-1.json requirement_statuses FUT-014 carries both scenarios and explicitly requires changed next-run behavior.
candidate evidence EV-OBSERVER-E2E, EV-LIFECYCLE-TESTS, and EV-WORK-MEMORY-TESTS grounds current partial proofs and their limitations.
raw_findings.practical_consequence: Completion could otherwise be claimed from post-run catalog records without proving that future behavior changed, so planning must preserve two real-boundary lifecycle proofs covering successful reuse and corrected non-recurrence.

evidence: EV-REQUIREMENTS defines authoritative producers, stable identity, outcome linkage, safe schemas, and fail-visible unsupported classes.
EV-CHECKED-EXEC limits authoritative action capture to explicitly wrapped argv subprocesses; EV-EXECUTOR and EV-CODEX-CLI retain aggregate model output rather than individual tool-action events.
raw_findings.practical_consequence: Without a planner-owned host integration boundary, most model actions remain invisible and the learning loop can silently miss behavior outside checked shell execution.

evidence: EV-REQUIREMENTS requires matching and enforced activation before dispatch.
EV-RUNNER-SKILL is advisory, EV-GUARD enforces only after explicit activation, and EV-OBSERVER records decisions from run_closed evidence after execution.
raw_findings.practical_consequence: Known correct sequences will not prevent improvisation until the planner places applicability matching and governed activation before the actual dispatch boundary.

evidence: EV-REQUIREMENTS defines complete evidence-only discovery and deduplication outcomes.

EV-OBSERVER can propose/bootstrap only from represented closed-run evidence, while EV-BOOTSTRAP validates a supplied complete spec but does not discover actions; EV-OBSERVER-E2E proves the governed path only.
raw_findings.practical_consequence: Successful behavior outside the governed checked-execution path will still require manual reconstruction unless planning connects ordered authoritative action outcomes to one deduplicated canonical discovery.

evidence: EV-REQUIREMENTS requires an evidence-backed causal join, canonical corrected content, and non-repetition proof.
EV-BLOCKER and EV-WORK-MEMORY persist blocker/correction/successor evidence, but EV-OBSERVER and EV-LIFECYCLE provide no producer that turns model self-diagnosis into an approved content repair.
raw_findings.practical_consequence: A model can identify its mistake yet the next matching task can still receive the wrong path unless planning joins the signal to grounded failure evidence and performs a verified canonical replacement or fail-closed hold.

evidence: EV-REQUIREMENTS defines versioned replacement and selectable-state acceptance.

EV-PROMOTION installs discoveries as registered sequences, while EV-LIFECYCLE and EV-WORK-MEMORY govern corrections within existing lineage/bundle evidence rather than a separately selectable replacement-version cutover.
raw_findings.practical_consequence: A defective registered sequence cannot be safely replaced while preserving an auditable old version and preventing stale selection until the planner defines quarantine, replacement identity, requalification, and atomic cutover.

evidence: EV-REQUIREMENTS supplies the lifecycle intent and grounded base semantics but explicitly leaves exact policy to be finalized.
EV-DISCOVERY, EV-PROMOTION, EV-REGISTRY, and EV-OBSERVER-E2E expose qualification, registration, verification, and post-run reuse analogues without canonical silver/gold state transitions.
raw_findings.practical_consequence: The system cannot distinguish captured reusable knowledge from proven real reuse until planning finalizes machine-readable silver and gold states and every transition that changes selectability.

evidence: EV-REQUIREMENTS defines the required effectiveness measures.

EV-WORK-MEMORY implements run-oriented metrics such as closed-run pass rates and corrections per run, while EV-OBSERVER records post-close decisions; neither evidence surface defines the complete learning-loop denominators or thresholds.
raw_findings.practical_consequence: Event counts could increase while learning remains ineffective unless planning defines eligible denominators, provenance, and thresholds for capture, real reuse, correction, false matches, holds, and recurrence.

evidence: EV-REQUIREMENTS requires immutable identity joins and declared future rule versions.

EV-RECONCILIATION governs immutable lifecycle dispositions and EV-OBSERVER consumes selected correction/reuse evidence, but the evidence index explicitly records partial consumption and no false-match feedback contract.
raw_findings.practical_consequence: Past outcomes can be durably recorded yet remain behaviorally inert unless planning specifies exactly how versioned rules consume promotion, reuse, correction, quarantine, dismissal, false-match, and recurrence evidence.

evidence: EV-REQUIREMENTS defines interruption, duplicate, lost-correction, stale-selection, and branch-safety acceptance.

EV-WORK-MEMORY, EV-BOOTSTRAP, and EV-PROMOTION provide durable atomic pieces, while EV-WORKFLOW-STATE persists workflow phase state; no cited current boundary owns synchronization across observation, candidate, correction, level, promotion, and reuse together.
raw_findings.practical_consequence: A restart or branch divergence can duplicate candidates, lose corrections, or preserve stale selection unless planning assigns one durable synchronization and resume contract across every learning transition.

evidence: EV-REQUIREMENTS already requires two explicit real-boundary proofs: success learning through next-run invocation and correction learning through non-repetition.

EV-OBSERVER-E2E, EV-LIFECYCLE-TESTS, and EV-WORK-MEMORY-TESTS establish that current tests stop short of those future proofs; FUT-014 is FUTURE_SYSTEM, so missing deployed proof is expected and planner-owned acceptance work.
raw_findings.practical_consequence: Treating absent deployed proof as another material research gap would duplicate the already-frozen future acceptance obligation rather than give the planner a new decision or mechanism to resolve.
